index.title: tacto — Web studio in Paris: simple, beautiful websites that stay yours
index.description: Web studio in Paris: custom websites, simple and beautiful, that you edit yourself. And that stay yours.

tarifs.title: Pricing — tacto
tarifs.description: €450 the first year, then €150 per year. Custom website, hosting, edits and 100 credits a year included. The site stays yours.

home.label: Web studio
home.title: Simple websites that <mark>draw</mark> people in.
home.lead: Businesses, brands, nonprofits, freelancers: we build your custom website, simple and beautiful. You edit your texts whenever you like, we handle the rest.
home.edit_text: Texts, prices, hours, news: as often as you like, free. The layout never breaks.
home.credits_text: New page, photos, a form: just ask, it's done within 24 hours.
home.tech_text: Hosting, security, updates: included, and off your mind.

pricing.credits_lead: Text changes are unlimited and free. For anything else, send a request from your space: you instantly see how many credits it takes, and it's handled within 24 hours.
pricing.credits_note: Online sales, payments, apps…: these are new projects, quoted separately.
pricing.own_lead: Your texts, your photos, your site: if you ever stop, you take it with you.

credit_labels.menu: Adding a menu or catalogue item

items.title: A first version, no commitment
items.text: We build a first version of your site with your real content. You see it before you commit.

items.title: You approve, we polish
items.text: If you like it, you approve and pay for the year. We then make one big round of changes, in a single back-and-forth.

items.title: Your domain name
items.text: We transfer yours, or buy one for you. If it needs buying, it isn't included (usually €10–20 a year).

items.title: Live
items.text: Your site goes live. From then on, your credits take over.

metodas.quote: We wanted an agency-level site without an agency budget. We got a custom design for the price of a subscription.
metodas.name: Audra R.

tableandco.quote: I update our prices and collections myself in two minutes. Before, every change took a week of back-and-forth.
tableandco.name: Aminta R.

revo.quote: The site was live in three days. And when we need a new page, it's done the next day.
revo.name: Matthieu L.
